payments.a: Yes. MyPOS integrates with all major Uzbek payment rails: Click, Payme, Uzum, Apelsin and Humo/Uzcard. Receipts print automatically.

offline.a: Yes. The POS accepts orders in offline mode. Data syncs to the server automatically when the connection is restored.

hardware.a: No. MyPOS runs on any Android or iOS tablet, phone or computer. A receipt printer makes it nicer but isn't required.

setup.a: About 30 minutes. After signup, our AI assistant helps import your menu from Excel or photos.

staff.q: How do my staff learn it?
staff.a: The interface is simple — training takes about 10 minutes. Guides and video lessons are available in UZ, RU and EN.

migration.q: How do I migrate from another system?
migration.a: We'll migrate your data from iCiko, Poster or Excel free of charge. The service is included in Pro and Business plans.

security.a: Yes. Servers are hosted in Uzbekistan (UZCLOUD), data is encrypted, daily backups are taken, and we comply with Uzbek data protection law.

support.a: Telegram and email support for all plans. Business tier gets 24/7 priority support and a dedicated account manager.
